violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no certified food manager at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Certified food manager arrived during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at the cook line and the back prep area are both at 91F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Person in charge contacted repair technician and a follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut tomato (62F), garlic and oil sauce (47F) in 2 door prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge placed items in walk in cooler to be properly cooled.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw lamb chops on back prep table at ambient temperature (71F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Person in charge placed lamb chops in walk in cooler for the remainder of the thawing process.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 door prep unit at (59F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge removed all items from cooler and contacted repair technician during inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days. FAROOJ ABU AL ABED (Inspection Date: 10/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed hot water at (91F).
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. Person in charge contacted repair technician during inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge provided test strips during inspection.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water source and system serving this food service establishment has been interrupted. Observed hot water at hand sinks and dish sinks at 91F.
violations.corrective_action: The water source and system shall be of sufficient capacity to meet the peak water demands of the food establishment. Person in charge contacted repair technician during inspection and a follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.
